item.title: How to Take a Walk—in Buffalo, and Beyond: Cars, Trucks, Vans, and Specialty Vehicles – Old, Weird, Modified, and Junked
item.description: We continue the series on walking Buffalo, from the intrepid couple who walked every day—no matter the weather—in the early years of Covid. They think (without being systematic) they walked every street in Buffalo, and many in other cities and towns, taking some 30,000 photos, shared in this series. While not usually itineraries, we hope to encourage others to “walk the walk,” to see, observe and appreciate Buffalo—and beyond. item.title: Hochul’s SUNY Reconnect Program is Increasing Enrollment at ECC While Decreasing Poverty in WNY
item.description: When my mom became a widow at age 66, she wanted to start a new chapter in her life. She went to work for a year in daycare with 4-year-olds and decided to get a two-year degree at ECC to become a certified head teacher. We were so proud! She had so many adventures, experiences and fun at ECC. It gave her a good job, which she held until she was 82. item.description: Reels at the Market Arcade cinemas will be spinning again in April. Previous operator AMC Theaters let its lease run out at the end of last year. After a refresh of the interior, Scene One is planning to be open April 1. item.title: Call for Short Films: Film Strip Fest Relocates from Atlanta to Buffalo
item.description: Buffalo is now home to Film Strip Fest, which originated in Atlanta, Georgia. This unusual multimedia film festival is a specialized, two-day mini-festival that combines independent short films with live burlesque performances. Film Fest Strip was founded by creative curator and producer Shellie Schmals in 2023.
